acceptanceCriteria: Inventory existing behavior and risks
Reproducible build, typecheck, lint and browser regressions
knownLimitations: Existing editor remains JavaScript; new domain modules are TypeScript.

acceptanceCriteria: Reject invalid rings
Correct touching/overlapping polygons and concave containment
Metric transforms and measurements tested
tests: Boundary-contact unit/browser regression: zero distance fails positive setback
knownLimitations: Interactive invalid parcel edits are visibly flagged; import rejection belongs to F003.

features.description: Versioned canonical scene and legacy sharing
acceptanceCriteria: Strict scene validation and migration from unversioned JSON and #p/#z
Full scene persists in local storage, JSON and new share URLs
Reject future versions without data loss
tests: Compression API fallback when deflate-raw is unavailable
knownLimitations: Shared links contain project geometry in the fragment and must be treated as public to their recipients.

features.description: Project files, variants and full undo/redo
acceptanceCriteria: Download and import JSON projects
Named local variants restore full scene
Undo and redo restore full scene
knownLimitations: Variants are local to this browser; JSON downloads provide portable backups.
Undo history is limited to 150 changes and is not persisted across reloads.

acceptanceCriteria: Rectangle, L, T and U footprints with editable dimensions
Same footprint drives SVG, collisions and coverage
Architectural height and roof controls persist
knownLimitations: Parametric user dimensions are conceptual. Concave pitched roofs use a flat schematic cap; rectangular gable/hip/shed roofs have pitch geometry.

acceptanceCriteria: Brick slip variants plus plaster, wood, clinker, stone, concrete and composite
Separate base and override data with per-material reset
Conceptual finishes clearly distinguished
tests: tests/browser/planner.spec.ts (8 passing after preserving expanded controls)
knownLimitations: Procedural textures, normal maps, physical repeats, per-wall finishes, roof coverings and separate door colors are conceptual. Detailed accent-area meshes and approved manufacturer materials require further design/assets.

features.description: Optional manufacturer catalogs with sourced plans and placeable envelopes
acceptanceCriteria: Explicitly registered lazy catalog with model versions and dated sources
Place DE75/105/135/165 using dimensions from public manufacturer floor plans
Public manufacturer photos and readable plan previews
Disable catalog without deleting saved buildings
knownLimitations: Verified main-building bounding envelopes exclude terraces, carports and roof overhangs. Heights, roof pitch, detailed openings and prices remain unverified. Public photos and plans are attributed to Udana Budowa.

acceptanceCriteria: Same transformed footprint and materials as SVG
Orbit, top and axonometric cameras and screenshot
Mobile quality settings and WebGL fallback
tests: tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts (3 tests: desktop, WebGL fallback, mobile/GPU resource stability)
knownLimitations: Conceptual massing; terrain, openings and walk camera are supported. Neighbor heights remain unknown; shadows are approximate. Optional Three.js and MapLibre bundles are lazy-loaded and large.

features.description: CRS-aware single-ring parcel import and arbitrary vertex editing
acceptanceCriteria: Validated Polygon and single-part MultiPolygon import, with explicit rejection of holes and separate parts
PL-1992 projection, reversible origin and source metadata
Arbitrary vertex parcel editor with undo/share support
knownLimitations: PL-1992 projected distances are planning measurements, not certified survey distances.
Import preserves building local positions; UI asks the user to verify placement.

acceptanceCriteria: Full identifier lookup with official WKT response fixture
Bounded requests, service failure fallback and attribution
Late responses cannot overwrite edited projects
tests: Live official example response and CORS header checked
knownLimitations: Map selection is implemented separately in F026.
No automatic retries or long-term service mirroring.

acceptanceCriteria: MapLibre orthophoto, cadastre and base maps where available
Visible attribution and provenance
North and nearby geometry
knownLimitations: Roads and neighboring buildings are visual raster context; no structured height data imported.
Provider image capture dates are unknown and disclosed.
MapLibre and its worker are lazy-loaded; map payload is larger than the 2D editor.

acceptanceCriteria: Elevation and slope
Verified planning/flood/environment/utility source adapters
Freshness and unavailable-source disclosure
knownLimitations: GUGiK nine-point elevation/slope, planning, utility, protected-area, flood, groundwater, relief, SOPO landslides, MIDAS mining/deposits and CBDH hydrogeological overlays use verified primary public services also used in Gruntometr. Coverage and freshness vary; rasters do not establish legal restrictions. Routing, property valuation and broadband analysis remain external references.

acceptanceCriteria: Rule provenance
Available building area and deterministic suggestions
Distinguish geometry from compliance
knownLimitations: Uniform user-defined setback geometry uses deterministic millimetre miter offsets; suggestions use a bounded grid and are not exhaustive or a legal feasibility decision.

acceptanceCriteria: Parametric structures, surfaces, furniture and vegetation
Physical dimensions and mature sizes
Consistent placement and rendering
knownLimitations: Parametric concept library with editable dimensions and maturity. Species-specific horticultural growth models and photorealistic assets are not claimed.

acceptanceCriteria: Path-following configurable fence types
Gate opening and driveway clearance
Hedge spacing and growth
knownLimitations: Fence and hedge paths support editable dimensions, spacing, color and gate opening geometry. Designs are procedural concepts, not engineering/manufacturer specifications.

acceptanceCriteria: Four seasonal presets
Independent physical solar position
Explicit approximate shadows
knownLimitations: Solar position is calculated with SunCalc 2.1.4 (degrees clockwise from north, converted to scene axes); source: https://github.com/mourner/suncalc . Four seasons and atmospheric presets are conceptual; shadows omit unknown neighboring heights and terrain.

acceptanceCriteria: Official capability/pricing review and configured bindings
Opt-in private text processing, strict schemas and citations
Bounded usage, caching and failure paths
knownLimitations: Authenticated opt-in Workers AI extraction, source-excerpt summaries/reports, registered catalog answers and validated layout proposals. Strict citations, quotas, cache and no automatic scene edits. PDF OCR and independent legal verification are not provided.

acceptanceCriteria: SVG export and print-to-PDF overview
Source timestamps and unknown restrictions
Catalog and conceptual customization disclosures
tests: tests/reports.test.ts (2 tests, including escaped user input)
Polish print PDF rendered and both pages visually inspected
knownLimitations: PDF uses the browser print/save dialog; no server PDF service.
No official planning restrictions or manufacturer prices are available; unknowns are explicit.
Report can include the current 3D view; external map imagery is not embedded.

acceptanceCriteria: Separate staging and production
No frontend secrets
API/storage/AI errors and usage monitoring when services added
knownLimitations: Separate EU D1 staging/production databases, isolated secrets, AI binding, Turnstile and scheduled retention. Worker invocation/error logging and sampled traces enabled; Cloudflare dashboards provide storage/neuron billing metrics.

acceptanceCriteria: Touch fullscreen, examples, guided flow and QR transfer
Inactivity warning/reset and visitor cleanup
First-party campaign metadata
knownLimitations: Fullscreen guided showroom, generic examples, QR scene transfer, first-party attribution and warning/reset. Autosave, undo, visitor data and server administration sessions are isolated. Manufacturer branding requires approved assets.

acceptanceCriteria: Voluntary disclosed inquiry with separate marketing consent
Scoped roles, tenant isolation, retention, deletion and Turnstile
Standalone management without CRM
knownLimitations: Standalone private inquiries, scoped owner/manufacturer/sales roles, Turnstile, explicit processing and optional marketing consent, deletion/export and audited retention. Public recipient activation requires actual controller identity and privacy disclosure; none enabled by deployment.

acceptanceCriteria: Configurable duplicate/window/exclusion rules
Contract/payment-confirmed eligibility and immutable audit
Deterministic reporting and CRM/webhook adapters
knownLimitations: Deterministic commission rules, confirmation references, immutable audit, private reports and CSV/API integration boundary. No external CRM, email, pricing or webhook recipient is configured and no external message is sent.

features.description: Verified manufacturer geometry and approved assets
acceptanceCriteria: Authoritative footprints, roof heights, openings and options
Approved asset rights and default appearance
Version migrations and fallback geometry
knownLimitations: Public dimensioned floor plans and manufacturer photos now support all four placeable model envelopes. Detailed ridge/eaves heights, roof pitch, full elevations/openings and an approved detailed 3D asset remain unavailable. The 3D envelope uses clearly labeled illustrative defaults. No manufacturer pricing is inferred.

acceptanceCriteria: Object grouping, visibility and locking
Custom footprint, garage/carport assemblies
Variant comparison and walkthrough camera
knownLimitations: Groups transform atomically and honor locking; custom normalized footprints, visibility, attached garage/carport objects, openings, hip/shed roofs, variant comparison and walk camera are implemented. Openings are conceptual facade geometry; walk camera has no physical collision simulation.

acceptanceCriteria: Preserve all components and holes in the scene
Containment, dimensions, rendering and export honor excluded areas
No silent geometry flattening
knownLimitations: Multipart polygons and holes persist, render and participate in containment and area calculations. Total topology is bounded to 512 vertices; intersecting or touching hole boundaries are rejected.

features.description: ULDK parcel selection by geographical map position
acceptanceCriteria: Select a parcel by map click using GetParcelByXY
Display imported boundary at its geographic location
Preserve current project when remote lookup fails or the project changes
tests: tests/uldk.test.ts (4 tests including coordinate query validation)
knownLimitations: Parcel topology restrictions from F025 still apply.
Buildings retain local positions after boundary replacement; verify placement.

features.description: Reviewed responsive workspace and manufacturer placement UX
acceptanceCriteria: Separate library, canvas and selected-object inspector
Responsive phone/tablet panels with explicit dismissal and correct focus/navigation state
Manufacturer photos, dimensioned plan zoom and persistent placement
Parcel layers and localized official source directory
Preserve legacy editing, sharing, projects and kiosk isolation
knownLimitations: Manufacturer representations use verified main-building envelopes with illustrative height/roof pitch. Optional 3D/map bundles remain lazy and exceed the documented Vite warning threshold.
